digest.component_or_area: Cloud outbound comment dedup and fitting
propositions: The differ's body-equality dedup key applies a plain 32,767-character cap via truncate_comment_body, while the Cloud send path fits via ADF serialization against a 32,000-byte limit with marker budget, so they cannot agree for over-length comments.

A 43,200-character body produces a dedup key of length 32,767 but a landed body of length 31,753, with first divergence at index 31,725, proving structural failure of the secondary skip guard for over-length comments.
The divergence was introduced by commit 27b868ba55, which moved the send path off the shared truncation helper to codec.fit_outbound while leaving the differ on the plain cap.

The defect violates the stated invariant in comment_limits.py that both paths must share one truncation helper or the loop persists; body-equality dedup becomes structurally dead for over-length comments.
